text:
Evan C: Heads up — I'm kicking off a throughput + steady-state run for windfall-13b on dedicated A100 and T4 pools. Need p95/p99 and tail-kv effects. Can folks run profiling when you have cycles?

Priya S: Thanks — what's the input distribution? short prompts, mixed, or long context? Also which batch sizes to test?

Evan C: Short mix: 8k tokens/day traffic mix but 8-64 token responses mostly. Please test: batch_size=[1,4,8], seq_len=256, kv_caching=on/off. Target to capture warmup + 10m steady-state.

Mateo R: I'll run on T4 (pool:dedicated-t4-us-west). Will collect perf counters + nvprof traces. ETA ~1.5h. Any specific env vars?

Evan C: Use bench harness branch: feature/windfall-steady. Set ENV: BENCH_WARMUP=120, BENCH_RUNTIME=600, PERF_EXPORT=s3://redwood-bench/windfall/2067894321/. Command: 
```
./bench_run --model windfall-13b --device cuda --batch $BATCH --seq 256 
```
Also include --kv-cache flag toggle.

Jin L: I'll do A100 run later today. Quick note: recent runtime patch changes to attention kernel might affect tail latency; I added logging to measure step-by-step token timings. I'll attach traces.

Olivia M: Re: regression checks, can we gate the canary route if p99 latency increases >15% vs baseline? I can wire a quick alert rule in console.

Evan C: Yes, please. Baseline is stored at s3://redwood-bench/baselines/windfall-13b/2067000000/baseline.json — compare p50/p95/p99 and GPU util.

bench-bot: bench job queued: job_id=job-94233, runner=dedicated-t4-us-west, start_ts=2067894430

Mateo R: quick notes after T4 run: warmup=2m looked necessary. Steady-state (after 3m) numbers (batch=4, seq=256, kv=on): p50=42ms, p95=125ms, p99=210ms, throughput=125 tokens/s. Attached perf link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bench/windfall/2067894321/t4-batch4-kv-on.json

Evan C: good. Can you also paste GPU metrics? util, memory, sm_efficiency?

Mateo R: GPU: util=78%, mem=48GB/80GB, sm_eff=62%. Observed occasional 1-2 spikes at ~1s due to IO prefetching.

Jin L: A100 run finished. batch=8, kv=on: p50=18ms, p95=60ms, p99=95ms, throughput=420 tokens/s. Traces: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bench/windfall/2067894321/a100-batch8-kv-on.json. Noticed microstutters tied to kernel selection falling back on dequant path at 90th percentile.

Priya S: Thanks. Any end-to-end quality diffs with quantized variants? We should include output divergence check in the harness.

Evan C: Agreed — add token-level diff + perplexity check against golden set. Mateo/Jin, can you re-run one sample set with quantized=8bit and attach diffs?

Mateo R: Will do a 1k-sample diff run tonight.

Jin L: I'll toggle quantized path tomorrow AM and re-run the A100 batch=8 test.

Olivia M: Alert rule drafted: windfall-13b-canary-latency — triggers if p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.15 AND throughput < baseline_throughput * 0.9 for 5m. Want me to enable for dedicated only?

Evan C: Enable for dedicated + hosted canary. We'll keep private off for now.

Mateo R: Uploaded kv-off results as well: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bench/windfall/2067894321/t4-batch4-kv-off.json — p99 went down ~12ms but throughput decreased ~8% due to recompute overhead.

Evan C: Solid. Next action items: 1) Mateo/Jin finish quantized diffs (assign to you). 2) Priya, add output-diff check to harness. 3) Olivia, enable alert and add dashboard panel for p50/p95/p99 + gpu util. 4) I'll open a PR with benchmark summary and rollup.

Priya S: On it — PR for harness changes will be under bench/harness#124.
